C220 Liver
C221 Intrahepatic bile duct 

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Liver-Hepatocellular Carcinoma* pages 110-113.
* Primary site C221 with histologies 8170-8175 is not listed in this chapter of the UICC manual; however, it is included in this schema, but is not TNM staged

**Note 2:** For primary site C220 and cholangiocarcinoma histologies (M-8160, 8161, and 8180), see the Bile DuctsIntraHepat schema.

**Note 3:** Although the presence of cirrhosis is an important prognostic factor, it does not affect the TNM classification, being an independent prognostic variable.

**Note 4:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Liver and Intrahepatic Bile Ducts* chapter on page 108 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=108).
